title: Epoch AI public enrichment bridge
purpose: Make every one of the 93 Epoch site records explicit about what additional public project facts have been captured from independent/public sources, while preserving a field-by-field disclosure boundary.

source_catalog.name: Intel Accelerator · Verified AI Data Center Registry
source_catalog.notes: Separate public enrichment layer. It may expose program/EPC/energy-partner facts not present in Epoch's publisher CSV. It is never used to overwrite Epoch IT-power accounting or invent queue IDs.

summary.blank_values_policy: Blank means the retained source set did not expose a defensible value. The accompanying field_status makes the distinction explicit; blanks are never interpreted as zero or absence.
